lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Single ~90 deg tab fold between the large flange (patch 1) and the 14 mm tab (patch 3). At the 25/50/75% perpendicular sections the label point sits on the apex of the outer arc. The inner skin is 1.89-1.92 mm inward along the bisector, which matches t=1.93, so the line is on the outer skin and not the inner one. The line runs parallel to the fold. Its 13.35 mm length spans essentially the full tab width (about 13.5 mm on the face-on close-up), from the patch-5 side face to the relief notch.
